name: Bloomer Mama to School Swimsuit Mama ~Jinroku Paradise~
original_name: ブルマママとスク水ママ ～甚六パラダイス～
source:
This is a voiced game that colors and animates 3 doujin manga:

1. 16-page doujin from Comic "Bloomer Mama Shinsouban" by Jingrock
2. 20-page doujin from Comic "Bloomer Mama Shinsouban" by Jingrock
3. 16-page doujin from Comic "Bloomer Mama Shinsouban" by Jingrock
translation:
这是一款为3个同人漫画着色和制作动画的有声游戏：

1. Jingrock漫画《Bloomer Mama Shinsouban》中的16页同人2. Jingrock漫画《Bloomer Mama Shinsouban》中的20页同人3. Jingrock漫画《Bloomer Mama Shinsouban》中的16页同人
